current_date: November 2024 (council page link text: 'Download the Torbay Council Local Validation List November 2024')
current_evidence: Torbay's 'local list' page links only 'Torbay Council Local Validation List November 2024' (media/21130 ...nov24-website-version-v3.docx). A search found no 2025/2026 revision, and the intermediate August 2024 PDF's version control lists Oct 2023 -> Apr 2024 -> Aug 2024 updates, so the 2023 docx Grokbot linked has been superseded at least three times.

issues.detail: Grokbot's link is the 2023 local validation list (media/20032). The council now publishes the November 2024 v3 list (media/21130); the 2023 version was replaced by the April 2024 and August 2024 BNG updates and then the November 2024 version. Grokbot read the Nov 2024 docx but still used the 2023 file as its reference link.
issues.evidence: Local list page: 'Download the Torbay Council Local Validation List November 2024' -> media/21130/local-validation-list-nov24-website-version-v3.docx

issues.detail: List date is blank and 'Outdated' is set to 'Undated', but the list is dated. The current version is November 2024, and the list's version-control table records an October 2023 comprehensive update with later April 2024 and August 2024 revisions. The page also says the list must be reviewed every two years, so a review is due around November 2026.
issues.evidence: Aug 2024 PDF version control: Oct 2023 comprehensive update; Apr 2024 BNG; Aug 2024 BNG and sections 1.3/1.4

issues.detail: Grokbot missed many local requirements (checked against the August 2024 PDF, because the Nov 2024 docx cannot be machine-read): 3.1.2 Statement of Community Involvement (major or contrary to plan); 3.1.7 Green Infrastructure Statement (all major); 3.1.8 Employment Statement/Economic Impact Assessment (major except residential under 30 dwellings, or loss of employment/tourist accommodation); 3.1.9 Independent Viability Assessment; 3.1.10 Infrastructure Assessment (foul/utilities, major); 3.1.13 Telecommunications Statement; 3.1.15 Coastal Change Vulnerability Assessment (Coastal Change Management Area); 3.1.16 Crime Prevention Statement (major residential/commercial, education, HMOs, ATMs, vulnerable C2/C3b); 3.2.2 Archaeological desk-based assessment; 3.2.4 Joinery details (replacement windows/doors affecting heritage assets); 3.3.3 Bat and Bird Screening Checklist (householder, demolition in CA, full); 3.3.4 Devon BNG Statement and 3.3.13 BNG exemption evidence; 3.4.2 Tree Protection Plan/AMS; 3.5.3 Travel Plan; 3.6.2 Flooding sequential test (new dwellings in FZ2/3); 3.6.3 Foul Drainage Assessment (non-mains); 3.7.2 Energy Statement (major); 3.8.1 Geological survey; 3.8.2/3.8.3 Contaminated land risk assessment and intrusive investigation; 3.8.6 Mineral Resource Impact Assessment (major in Mineral Safeguarding Area); 3.9.1 Open Space, Sports and Recreation Assessment; 3.10.2 Noise Impact Assessment; 3.10.3 Shading diagrams/sun path; 3.11.4 Ventilation and extraction details; 3.12.1 Pollution Prevention Plan (demolition/major within 250 m of Lyme Bay and Torbay SAC); 3.12.2 Structural Survey.
issues.evidence: Aug 2024 list sections 3.1-3.12, e.g. '3.12.1 Pollution Prevention Plans: Demolition or major development within 250 m of the Lyme Bay and Torbay SAC'

issues.detail: The Wildlife & Geology Trigger Table (3.3.1) is required for ALL applications, including prior approvals (4.2.13). It is Torbay's key local form, but Grokbot never lists it as a requirement under any application type; it appears only inside the ecology trigger text.
issues.evidence: '3.3.1 Wildlife & Geology Trigger Table: All applications'; '4.2.13 Wildlife & Geology Trigger Table: All applications'

issues.detail: 'Change of use - prior approval' is marked '(none)', but the list has a section 4.2, 'Local Prior Approval and Prior Notification Items': elevations, floor plans, shading diagrams, site plan showing waste storage, Impact Assessment of the Change of Use (key shopping areas / employment areas), noise, transport statement, ventilation/extraction, contaminated land, air quality, lighting, Wildlife & Geology Trigger Table and wildlife report. Section 4.1 also says an FRA is usually required for all prior approvals because Torbay is a Critical Drainage Area.
issues.evidence: '4.2 Local Prior Approval and Prior Notification Items'; '4.1.4 Flood Risk Assessment: All applications. Usually required given Torbay's Critical Drainage Area status'

issues.detail: Several rows are '(none)' or incomplete although the source has requirements for them. Minerals & waste (Torbay is a unitary minerals/waste authority): 3.8.5 Mineral Extraction Impact Assessment, 3.8.8 Restoration and Aftercare Scheme, 3.13.2 Waste Planning Statement. S106 modification: 3.1.14 contact details of the applicant's legal practitioner. Advertisement consent: 3.5.4 Highways Statement where the site is within the highway boundary.
issues.evidence: '3.13.2 Waste Planning Statement: All waste applications'; '3.5.4 Advertisement Consent – Highways Statement'

issues.detail: The CIL Additional Information Form was placed under Householder, but Grokbot's own excerpt says householder applications are excluded (as are LBC and demolition in a conservation area).
issues.evidence: Grokbot excerpt: '3.14.1 ... All applications for built development ... with the exception of: Householder Applications'

issues.detail: Several requirements sit under the wrong application type. The S106 legal practitioner contact item (3.1.14, for applications to modify/discharge a planning obligation) was placed under Full planning as 'S106 draft Heads of Terms', while the S106 modification row says '(none)'. The 'Lawful development cert' rows come from the 'Certificate of Lawfulness of Proposed Works to a listed building' checklist, which is a listed-building procedure, not a lawful development certificate. Block plan and Landscaping under Full planning come from the hedgerow removal notice checklist. The Heritage statement (3.2.1, any works affecting a heritage asset) appears only under LBC and LDC, not under Householder/Full.
issues.evidence: Rows 25, 46-47, 9, 21; '3.1.14 Contact details of applicant's legal practitioner: Applications to modify or discharge a S106 planning obligation'

issues.detail: 22 rows say 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning' without checking the trigger. Many are limited to major development (AQA 3.11.1 major in or within 500 m of an AQMA; HIA screening, 30+ dwellings or more than 1,000 sq m; Design Code, phased major; Parking statement), while others apply to all types (tree survey, lighting, land stability, ecology).
issues.evidence: e.g. Air Quality row: 'For major development proposals within an Air Quality Management Area (AQMA), or within 500m of an AQMA'

issues.detail: Some requirement names are attached to text about a different item. 'Agricultural / rural workers' dwelling appraisal' uses ALC survey text; the list has no such requirement. 'Daylight / Sunlight / Overshadowing' uses the 3.10.1 Lighting Assessment text instead of 3.10.3 Shading Diagrams. 'Sequential / Exception Test (flood)' uses the retail sequential test sentence ('main town centre uses') instead of 3.6.2 (new dwellings in FZ2/3). 'Schedule of works (listed building)' under Full uses Tree Protection Plan/AMS text, and under Demolition in CA it is the 3.12.3 Demolition Method Statement. 'Energy / Sustainability Statement' uses the sustainability checklist text rather than 3.7.2 Energy Statement.
issues.evidence: Grokbot excerpts: 'However, a sequential test assessment must be carried out for all main town centre uses.'; '& Arboricultural Method Statement (as applicable)...'

issues.detail: Some trigger excerpts are table-header or checklist fragments rather than triggers. Full 'Flood Risk Assessment' and Outline 'CIL' rows dump the checklist index ('Local List Reference Document Submitted ✓ N/A – please explain why... 3.1.1 Planning Statement 3.1.2...'). 'Agricultural Land Classification' omits the threshold (5 ha or more, or cumulative loss of 20 ha+ of Grade 1, 2 or 3a). 'Fire Statement' is cut off at 'the provision of one or more relevant buildings'.
issues.evidence: Rows 16, 35, 5, 15; '3.8.7 Agricultural Land Classification and Soil Statement: Applications of 5 ha or more, or cumulative loss of 20 ha or more'

issues.detail: Some tab items and rows are process text or boilerplate: the 'Submission rules' items on invalid applications and validation disputes, the Design Review Panel link, 'We deal with a high number of invalid applications...', and the 'Pre-application advice' row (text saying local requirements may sometimes not be needed). Tab item 0 is a garbled fragment ('A template FDA form is available online here: 3.7 Energy and Sustainability DOCUMENT WHEN IS IT REQUIRED...'). Fourteen of the 18 tab items just say 'A completed checklist should be included with your application' for each checklist and capture none of the list's roughly 80 numbered requirements.
issues.evidence: Tab items 0, 15-17; row 27 '1.3 Pre-Application Advice ... there may be times where the local requirements are not needed'

summary: Grokbot links the superseded 2023 Torbay list instead of the November 2024 v3 list the council page now offers, and leaves it undated. The extraction covers only a fraction of the roughly 80 numbered local requirements: noise, contaminated land, the Wildlife & Geology Trigger Table, crime prevention, green infrastructure and the prior-approval section are among those missed. Several rows have the wrong application type (e.g. CIL under Householder) or text from a different item.
